notes: The person's private key, locked with their password (contract/crypto/lock.json: salt, iterations, then the lock; aad person:<user id>), so that signing in with the password on a new device opens it. PUT /api/me/password takes it too, as password_lock: changing the password without one drops the old lock, and an admin's new password drops it as well. 409 no_key for a person without a key.
